disposition_reason: Iron, copper, manganese, lead, zinc and cadmium were measured by flame AAS in 175 potato and corn chip samples from 24 products sold in Jordan; Tables 2 to 5 give product, flavor and country-of-manufacture means.

study.design: Retail survey of 175 potato and corn chip samples from 24 products
study.origin: manufactured in Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Lebanon and Turkey (Table 5)
study.market: shops in Al-Karak and Amman, Jordan
study.method: Mashed, dried 105 °C 1 h; HNO3/H2O2 wet digestion at 130 °C; flame AAS (Varian)
study.qa: NIST SRM 1573 tomato leaves recoveries Fe 91.4, Cu 88.7, Mn 93.3, Zn 92.2, Cd 98.7% (no Pb recovery reported); blanks; 7 or 3 replicates
